messages.subject: Create DF of Parm estimates from many .out files
messages.subject_clean: Create DF of Parm estimates from many .out files
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

First. Thank you for this super package.  Second. I was wondering if anyone had thoughts on the following… I’m banging my head against the wall at this point J.

I’m doing some idiographic work, where we’re using N= 1 bivariate cross-lagged VAR  models, separately for ~ 50 dyad (moms and kids).

I’ve batched the models, so I have results for each of the ~50 individuals.  And I’ve used “readModels” to extract all the info from these models into R.

E.g., TB_out <- readModels("C:/Users/dberry/Dropbox/Idiograph", recursive=TRUE)

My aim is take the DICs, and estimated regression, residual variance, and residual covariance parameters from these 50 models and create a dataframe, where the row represents person (i.e., 50 rows for 50 people) and the columns represent the model parameters.

Basically, I just want to create a dataset, where I can look at the distributions of these parameters estimates across dyads. (i.e., is it at all reasonable to invoke normality assumptions and fit the same model as a multi-level VAR).

Thanks in advance for any thoughts!

Best,

-dan berry

messages.body_plain:
Hi Dan and Joe,

Thanks for the link to those files, Joe. That's a useful resource indeed! Dan, you might also look at the code for our Monte Carlo example from the MplusAutomation paper in Structural Equation Modeling, though this may be overkill for your purpose. The code for this is here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/tree/master/examples/monte_carlo.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject_clean: extracting "Logits for the Classification Probabilities for the Most Likely Latent Class Membership"
messages.body_plain:
Hi, Groups.

I'm Junyeong.
I'm conducting a simulation study about comparison of one-step approach and three-step approach in LTA with covariate.
For this reason, I had to make input and run a lot of files under various conditions and started to find out the methods with this MplusAutomation.
 * Because, I could not automatically run the batches of model and make cprob files of every single time point with Mplus.

I studied in order to make a lot of input file and MplusAutomation was really helpful for me.
Thanks.

To conduct my research, I need to do another step to extract 'Logits for the Classification Probabilities for the Most Likely Latent Class Membership" from each time point's lca output file.

I refered to https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/blob/master/R/parseOutput.R#L1890.

However, I don't know exactly how to extract the logits.

I run the syntax of https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/viewvc.php/pkg/R/utilityFunctions.R?view=markup&revision=30&root=mplusautomation&diff_format=l&pathrev=30
and https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/blob/master/R/parseOutput.R#L1890.

After these, I saved the sample outputfile on my working directory, and typed the syntax as below.

extractClassCounts("classficationLogitprobs", getwd())

The result is as below.

list()

I need to extract a lot of 'logits' from each results of lca in certain directory.
Can I get your help for extracting 'logits'.

Thank you for reading.

Sincerely,
